# Maintaining the Documentation

Manual meaning, exhaustive route/project evidence, AI discovery, and browser publication should move together rather than becoming independent stale products.

## One authoritative generation

```sh
node scripts/docs/generate-docs.js
```

This regenerates route/contract/caller/config/test/realtime evidence, project/symbol/dependency/public-entry/coverage evidence, one route tutorial per current API route, one project tutorial per current boundary, enriched AI records, and bounded public data.

Never hand-edit generated artifacts.

## Focused tests

```sh
node scripts/docs/project-evidence-test.js
node scripts/docs/tutorial-engine-test.js
node scripts/docs/search-engine-test.mjs
```

The project test validates representative owner/dependency/public-entry joins. The route test protects route identity/unknown-method behavior. The search test exercises the real publication corpus.

## Unified validator

```sh
node scripts/docs/validate-docs.js
```

The gate checks human Markdown/links/coverage, generator syntax/line limits, derech health evidence, route tutorials, project tutorials, AI records, public shard counts/identities/size ceilings, lossless Markdown reconstruction, and frontend safety/line/syntax contracts.

## Manual versus generated

Write manuals for purpose, architecture, trust, workflow, migration, caveats and failure modes. Generate volatile counts, routes, project boundaries, imports, callers, tests, symbols, dependencies and entries. Avoid freezing changing counts into prose.

## Project documentation workflow

1. Inspect exact project path/type and local documentation.
2. Inspect generated project tutorial, public entries and dependency evidence.
3. Follow source entries/symbols into exact implementation.
4. Use API/realtime/data/security docs for specialized behavior.
5. Change implementation/tests.
6. Update human project/system manuals when meaning changes.
7. Regenerate and run project/search/frontend/public gates.

## Frontend/publication workflow

Keep browser modules/styles split below 120 lines. Maintain safe DOM rendering and local-only convenience state. Preserve manifest-driven bounded sharding as project packets gain evidence rather than allowing a few giant JSON responses.
